title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Line Graph – Household Recycling Rates
prompt: The line graph below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in four different cities (A, B, C and D) between 2005 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据折线图描述主要特征并进行比较，字数不少于150词。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
